content.text: where does the slot header live

The header is fixed-width and the slot table starts at 0x40, read out of the file rather than inferred.

| offset | field | value |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | magic | 0x424e4400 |
| 0x0010 | slot_count | 10 |
| 0x0014 | state | 0x01 |
| 0x0040 | first slot | 0x00000200 bytes |
